purpose: Measure three post-discovery technical-line phrase families against one complete pinned arXiv robotic-manipulation parent; diagnostic, not independent detection
limitations: The line families were selected after reviewing prior robotic-manipulation proposals, so this is not an independent detection or precision test.
Literal title/abstract matches are mentions, not confirmed primary results or one coherent mechanism.
A phrase in the current title is a stronger retrieval anchor than an abstract-only mention but does not verify primary-result status or historical v1 wording.
The pinned current metadata may contain phrases added in later preprint versions; first-submission dates do not prove historic text presence.
arXiv metadata does not establish independent organisations, commercial adoption or a full worldwide scientific denominator.
A zero or small count in this arXiv parent cannot prove the absence of a line elsewhere.
